# Campaign graph — compiled topology

**Generated by `services/core/scripts/draw_graph.py` — do not edit by hand.**
Regenerate after any change to `graph/builder.py`.

Interrupt (pause) points: `await_draft`, `request_revision`,
`approval_gate`, `record_publication`, `monitor` (tick loop), `escalate`.
Each is resumed by an MCP tool call (creator), a REST call
(approver/operator), or the daily scheduler (monitor).

```mermaid
---
config:
  flowchart:
    curve: linear
---
graph TD;
	__start__([<p>__start__</p>]):::first
	pick_trend(pick_trend)
	generate_brief(generate_brief)
	await_draft(await_draft)
	score_asset(score_asset)
	poll_f1x8(poll_f1x8)
	evaluate_score(evaluate_score)
	request_revision(request_revision)
	approval_gate(approval_gate)
	record_publication(record_publication)
	monitor(monitor)
	write_learnings(write_learnings)
	escalate(escalate)
	__end__([<p>__end__</p>]):::last
	__start__ --> pick_trend;
	approval_gate -.-> __end__;
	approval_gate -.-> record_publication;
	approval_gate -.-> request_revision;
	await_draft --> score_asset;
	escalate -.-> __end__;
	escalate -.-> approval_gate;
	escalate -.-> score_asset;
	evaluate_score -.-> approval_gate;
	evaluate_score -.-> request_revision;
	generate_brief --> await_draft;
	monitor -.-> write_learnings;
	pick_trend --> generate_brief;
	poll_f1x8 -.-> escalate;
	poll_f1x8 -.-> evaluate_score;
	record_publication --> monitor;
	request_revision -.-> approval_gate;
	request_revision -.-> score_asset;
	score_asset -.-> escalate;
	score_asset -.-> evaluate_score;
	score_asset -.-> poll_f1x8;
	write_learnings --> __end__;
	monitor -.-> monitor;
	poll_f1x8 -.-> poll_f1x8;
	classDef default fill:#f2f0ff,line-height:1.2
	classDef first fill-opacity:0
	classDef last fill:#bfb6fc
```
